newsitem.title: UK: Quadrant makes 5.6 mln stg cash call.
newsitem.headline: Quadrant makes 5.6 mln stg cash call.

text.p: Quadrant Group Plc said on Friday that it plans to raise around 5.6 million stg through a placing and open offer of 5.6 million shares at 100p per share to provide it with additional working capital.
The offer is on the basis of three shares for every 20 ordinary shares.
The company said the offer price reflects a sub-division and consolidation of its share price, being equivalent to an offer price of 5p per share.
Quadrant said the 23 percent discount to the mid-market price of its shares reflects the need to repay a loan to Carlton Communications Plc.
Quadrant expects an improved performance over the next 12 months.
The company is organised into three businesses; precision engineering, video and security systems and flight simulation and training.
